name: AB-Cloud unified CLI contract
description: The binding contract implemented identically by python/julia/rust/go/js/bash runners.

output.metrics: flat dict (see shared/metrics.json for the canonical key set)

events: JSONL stream: {ts, event, level, detail} — progress/warning/error/done
invariants: all runners emit identical metrics keys and values from shared/metrics.json
all runners read config.yaml for seed/lang/theme/mode
JSON mode (--output=json) prints pure JSON on stdout
rh_status is always 'blocked' — the V13 obligation machine
exit code 0 on success, 1 on error, 2 on usage
